Subject: Staged billing ask + credit cap question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Nephron is excited to move from pilot to paid. Before we lock in consumption, finance asked me to propose concrete billing mechanics. Two asks:

1) We need a 60-day payment window for the first two quarters (Net60) while we sync our AR system; after that we expect to move to Net30.
2) Because our usage will spike during model onboarding, can Redwood provide a provisional credit ceiling (EUR) for the first 90 days that would allow us to run ahead of invoicing? We can provide a PO and a letter of credit if needed.

Attached is a draft PO and our standard purchase terms. We also flagged an early-pay discount possibility (2% if paid within 15 days).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept staged invoice timing + a temporary credit buffer, and what docs you need to set the ceiling?

Best,
Alyssa

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a phased payment profile and a provisional credit buffer, but we need a few items to finalize terms and set internal controls. Proposed approach below.

What Redwood needs to proceed:
- Signed PO (you attached a draft; we need the signed copy with billing address and VAT number)
- Completed credit questionnaire (I attached our one-page form to this thread — happy to have Finance reach out directly)
- Bank reference or letter of credit for the requested provisional ceiling (we can accept a canonical bank confirmation or an internal finance attestation)

Suggested operational terms (what we'd put in the SOW/invoice cadence):
- Trial ramp phase (90 days): invoices issued weekly for usage, payment terms Net45 (compromise between Net60 request and our billing cadence). During ramp, we will set a provisional credit ceiling of EUR 120,000.
- Stabilized phase (after 90 days): invoices issued monthly, standard Net30.
- Early-pay discount: we can offer 1.5% if paid within 15 days during the ramp phase, 2% thereafter.
- Overages: if monthly usage pushes the outstanding balance above the provisional ceiling, we'll pause non-essential burst capacity and notify both parties 48h before throttling.

Operational notes:
- Naomi (cc) will own credit evaluation. Connor will coordinate billing/PO ingestion on our side.
- If you need Net60 for internal approval, we can accept a signed amendment that converts to Net45 for Redwood billing systems and commit to honoring the Net60 on your ledger — but we will require the bank/finance confirmation to set the ceiling.

If that approach sounds OK I can have Finance send the questionnaire and draft an amendment showing the provisional ceiling and throttling guardrails.

Thanks — talk soon.

—

Alyssa — got the signed PO, thank you. Quick next steps and owners: 

- Naomi (Finance): expected turnaround for credit questionnaire = 48 business hours once we get the bank reference. Can you ask finance@nephronlabs.com to reply with the bank contact or uploaded confirmation?
- Connor (Billing Ops): yes — weekly invoice batches will include a per-invoice CSV export with token and request-level usage (we'll redact PII). Connor will send a sample CSV by end of day Monday.
- Legal / amendment: I'll draft a two-paragraph amendment that preserves your internal Net60 label while implementing Net45 for Redwood's ledger and setting an explicit provisional ceiling of EUR 120,000 for 90 days. The amendment will also codify the 2% early-pay discount during ramp.

Operational note on throttling: rather than a hard stop, we'll put a 48-hour soft notice window. If usage continues to push beyond the ceiling after notice, we will (a) suspend burst capacity, (b) provide an emergency invoice for the delta, and (c) escalate to execs if unresolved. That matches what we do for most pilot-to-paid transitions.

Please confirm you will: (1) provide bank reference or confirmation; (2) accept the provisional ceiling and early-pay discount as described. Once Naomi confirms the questionnaire turnaround we'll move the amendment and kickoff.

Cheers,
Soojin
